items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Oh that's a relation to me too. Well he's related.

ctx.x: Oh yes. Lewis James told us about that band. I guess you knew him up there too.

Oh that's a relation to me too. Well he's related. I didn't know that's right. That's right. Yeah. There's a little four cousins but they're related. They all played in the same band. Well my uncles, Clay Giles, Oscar Giles, Olivier Giles, where I know of them were playing in brass band was in Yardins. They all moved down here then? That's right. They all moved down. We all had this. And uh, Clay Giles played with the Exoultal Brass band. Oscar Giles played with the old Onward's J.F. band. Also,

I'm gonna put this up here to prevent six kids from interrupting as the wind is blowing against the microphone. Makes the needle jump a little bit. It's nice to have that breeze here on the hot Davidson. That's better now. Okay, excuse me. You were talking about your uncles now?
